units.source_text: 信辅交朋友的原则是对方必须有才能。

en.t: Shinsuke's rule for making friends was that the other person had to have talent.

units.source_text: 就算是品行端正的君子，如果除了品性之外没什么才能，对他来说都是没用的路人。

en.t: Even a morally upright gentleman, if he had no talent beyond his character, was to him a useless passerby.

units.source_text: 不，毋宁说每次见到他们，他都自然的表现这种态度，

en.t: No, rather, whenever he saw such people, he naturally showed this attitude,

units.source_text: 甚至不得不揶揄这些丑角。

en.t: and even could not help mocking these clowns.

units.source_text: 操行分只有六分的他，从初中到高中，从高中到大学，

en.t: With only six marks for conduct, as he went from middle school to high school, and from high school to university,

units.source_text: 在几个阶段的学校生活里，他总是不由的嘲笑那种人。

en.t: through the several stages of school life, he was always unable to keep from laughing at such people.

units.source_text: 他们之中当然有人对这种嘲笑感到愤怒。

en.t: Among them, of course, there were some who became angry at this ridicule.

units.source_text: 不过，也有人对这种嘲笑始终保持正人君子的态度。

en.t: However, there were also some who maintained the attitude of proper gentlemen toward this ridicule from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 对于自己被称为“令人讨厌的人”，他还多多少少感觉开心。

en.t: Being called an "unpleasant person" even made him feel, to some extent, pleased.

units.source_text: 可是，不管怎么嘲讽对方，却得不到任何回应，

en.t: But when he mocked the other person however he could and still got no response at all,

units.source_text: 他就不得不愤怒了。

en.t: he could not help becoming angry.

units.source_text: 其实，曾经有过这样一个君子——

en.t: In fact, there once was one such gentleman--

units.source_text: 高中时候的一个文科同学，一个利文斯通的崇拜者。

en.t: a humanities classmate from high school, an admirer of Livingstone.

units.source_text: 信辅在跟他住同一间校舍的时候，

en.t: When Shinsuke was living in the same school building as him,

units.source_text: 曾经信口开河的对他说，

en.t: he once said to him off the top of his head,

units.source_text: 连拜伦读了利文斯通的传记之后，也感动的流泪满面。

en.t: that even Byron, after reading Livingstone's biography, was moved until tears streamed down his face.

units.source_text: 从那个时候开始，到现在已经过去了二十年了，

en.t: Twenty years had already passed since that time,

units.source_text: 那个利文斯通的崇拜者在某基督教会机关志上，

en.t: and that admirer of Livingstone, in the journal of a certain Christian church,

units.source_text: 还在歌颂斯文利通。

en.t: was still singing the praises of Livingstone.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，

en.t: Nor was that all.

units.source_text: 文章的开头还有这样一段话：

en.t: At the beginning of the article there was also a passage like this:

units.source_text: “连恶魔诗人拜伦读了利文斯通的传记也感动的泪流满面，

en.t: "Even Byron, the demonic poet, read Livingstone's biography and was moved until tears streamed down his face;

units.source_text: 这让我们想到了什么呢？”

en.t: what does this make us think of?"
